data.body: **P1:** Falling back to the persisted link only helps when this method is called again. If a child becomes terminal before the process exits, startup does not scan terminal children or invoke this method, so the parent remains stuck in `STARTED`; the new restart test masks this by calling the private method manually. Reconcile persisted terminal children during runner/executor startup (or persist and redrive terminal notifications), and cover an actual stop/start sequence without manually triggering notification.
